'''Jettero Heler''' was the [[President/Legends|president]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hashaulh]].

==Biography==
===Pre-Presidency===
At some point in time, Jettero Heler served as the [[Vice President/Legends|vice president]] for the [[Development Commission]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and represented the Outer Rim planet, Hashaulh. After being awed at the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]], Heler wanted the frontier life. To get that, Heler began doing shady deals in the Senate, which caught the eye of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Prelude to ANH" />

To become [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], Palpatine needed help from Heler and other associates to run for office. However, Heler chose not to run for the sake of Hashaulh and the president of the planet, [[Joran Wostikian]], who would make Heler the godfather of his son, [[Soltan Wostikian|Soltan]]. Informing Wostikian about his offer, Joran asked Heler to resign from office and leave the Senate. Heler, who obeyed Joran, resigned from the Senate. Days later, Joran and his [[Joran Wostikian's wife|wife]] were killed in a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] accident, and Heler was elected President of Hashaulh. Heler later adopted Soltan and sent him to the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|Univeristy of Alderaan]].<ref name="Prelude to ANH" />

Jettero Heler later became senator and supported Palpatine in the Senate. However, a band of senators, led by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], grow fearful of Palpatine as being [[Emperor/Legends|emperor]]. To combat this, [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] proposes the construction of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. Palpatine allows the project, and the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] began construction on the planet [[Despayre]] in the [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]], which was closed to Hashaulh's asteroid belt.<ref name="Prelude to ANH" />

To make sure nobody witnesses the creation of the planet killer, Heler created a "no man's land" outside of Hashaulh, which prevented both others and Marauders to enter the zone.<ref name="Prelude to ANH" />
